v0.0.5.1
RIMVISION – MULTIPLAYER COMPATIBILITY
Experience your colony together.
Walk through your base, take control of a colonist and join your friends in the life of your colony. This add-on connects RimVision's first-person gameplay to Multiplayer, synchronizing your actions in the shared game.
FEATURES
• Move and control colonists in first person during a multiplayer session. • Fight, use equipment and interact with the world. • Build, carry resources and work at crafting stations. • Manage inventory, carry items and characters, eat and sleep. • Designate zones and work with roofs. • Keep control sessions when saving and loading the colony. • Use your own camera, interface and visual effects.
Actions that affect the colony are synchronized through Multiplayer. Each player's camera and visual settings remain local.
REQUIREMENTS
• RimWorld 1.6. • Harmony. • Multiplayer. • RimVision.
This is an add-on for RimVision. All players need the same versions of RimVision, Multiplayer and this compatibility mod, with matching mod lists.
INSTALLATION
Enable the required mods on every player's computer in this order:
Harmony → Core and DLC → Multiplayer → RimVision → RimVision – Multiplayer Compatibility.
Restart RimWorld after installing or updating the mods, then host or join a Multiplayer session.
GETTING STARTED
Load the colony and use RimVision's usual controls:
O: enter 3D or return to the standard view. V: switch between overview and first-person view. WASD: move. Mouse: look around. Alt: release the cursor. E: interact. Right mouse button: action menu. F: combat mode. Left mouse button: attack in combat mode. B: construction and zones. Tab: character and inventory. Q: cancel the current action.
Contextual hints show additional controls.
COMPATIBILITY AND DEVELOPMENT
The add-on is in active development. Desync-free gameplay is not guaranteed.
When reporting an issue, include the game log, a Multiplayer desync report if available, your mod list, and the steps to reproduce the issue. Describe what each player was doing when it occurred.
THANKS
Thanks to the Multiplayer team, Brrainz for Harmony, Tynan and Ludeon Studios for RimWorld, and everyone helping with testing and feedback.
